# Incorta Leadership Team

Meet our visionary leadership team: including former executives and senior leaders from Alteryx, Apple, IBM, Meta, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, & Tableau.

Osama Elkady

CEO and Co-founder

Osama has more than 25 years of enterprise software experience. Prior to co-founding Incorta, he was VP of Oracle Applications Development. For two decades Osama developed and helped bring to market Oracle’s enterprise applications and business intelligence tools. He holds multiple patents related to data management and has invented new approaches to mobile strategy and information discovery.

Hichem Sellami

Chief Solutions Architect and Co-founder

Hichem is a data warehouse and analytics expert and has design experience in a variety of industries, including project management, accounting, financial services, insurance, health services, pharmaceuticals, supply chain and human resources. Hichem spent nearly a decade at Oracle as an applications developer and software development director. Prior to Oracle, Hichem spent seven years at Siebel and helped develop Siebel Analytics. He holds two master’s degrees and a PhD in mathematics and industrial engineering from the University of Wisconsin-Madison.

Co-founder and Advisor

Klaus has more than two decades as a software developer and product manager. Klaus co-founded Incorta after more than a dozen years at Oracle where he was a director and developed business intelligence applications including BI Publisher. Klaus is a seasoned veteran of the analytics space. He started his career as a software developer in Germany. Klaus holds an advanced degree in computer science and an MBA from UC Berkeley.

Rob Dillon

CFO

Rob has over 20 years of experience in finance and accounting for software companies. Prior to joining Incorta, he was SVP and CFO of Navis, where he led all global finance and administration functions and drove their M&A and business transformation strategies. Rob has also held leadership positions at Zebra Technologies, where he led finance and accounting for their supply chain software M&A practice, and at Lennar Corporation, scaling operations through hyper-growth and managing a multibillion-dollar P&L. He started his career at Ernst & Young, focused on audit and assurance for software and technology. He holds a BS in accounting from Saint Mary’s College and is a California CPA (inactive).
